visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young Asian male with short black hair is standing in a brightly lit, modern architectural space with a curved white wall and a staircase. He is wearing a black T-shirt with a yellow lanyard and a black backpack. He holds an orange-colored smartphone with a triple-lens camera system toward the camera, pointing at its back. The background is filled with a dense crowd of people holding various devices, some wearing lanyards, suggesting a tech event. (2) The camera zooms in to a close-up of the phone's back and side. The phone has a matte orange finish. The camera module features three large lenses with metallic copper-colored rings. The person's fingers point to the seamless edge where the glass meets the aluminum frame. (3) The perspective shifts to the front of the phone, showing a bright display with a clock and date. The male uses his thumb to scroll through the interface. The lighting reflects off the screen, showing an anti-reflective coating. (4) A close-up of the phone's screen displays a camera application. The man demonstrates the zoom functionality, shifting the view from a wide crowd shot to a highly magnified view of people in the distance. The frame rate of the on-screen camera preview appears smooth. (5) The man holds the phone up to show a dual-view camera mode where a small inset window shows his own face while the main frame shows the scene in front of him. He continues to gesture toward the screen and look into the camera lens. (6) The camera focuses on the side profile of the device, highlighting two thin gray antenna lines embedded in the frame. The background remains a blur of event attendees and white architectural elements. (7) The male returns to a medium shot, holding the phone near his face and smiling, concluding the demonstration in the crowded hall.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 我們第一時間已經拿到最新的 iPhone 17 Pro Max. [Logo]: Joeman. (2) [Subtitle]: 然後這是橘色. (3) [Subtitle]: 那這橘色是一體成形的 所以可以看到在側邊. (4) [Subtitle]: 它是用新的鋁合金挖孔挖起來. (5) [Subtitle]: 它前後都有最新的陶瓷晶盾. (6) [Subtitle]: 所以它其實是有一個色差的. (7) [Subtitle]: 那這個橘色如果你近距離看的話 是有點消光橘. (8) [Subtitle]: 有點難駕馭但其實是蠻美的. (9) [Subtitle]: 這一代它有增加新的抗反光塗層. (10) [Subtitle]: 所以相對的 如果你在沒有貼保貼的情況下 它比較抗反光. (11) [Subtitle]: 然後呢 最大的改動還是這個拍照. (12) [Subtitle]: 這個拍照現在是從0.5倍 1倍之中 多了一個 4倍. (13) [Subtitle]: 然後你8倍都可以直接給它的特進去 有沒有 非常非常特 8倍. (14) [Subtitle]: 有前後鏡頭時捕捉. (15) [Subtitle]: 所以這個同時有我的臉之外呢 也可以同時錄前面. (16) [Subtitle]: 它這邊有天線 上面都是為了天線. (17) [Subtitle]: 這一代的收訊應該會很好. (18) [Subtitle]: 因為它整個重新打造它的這個機身 下面這個其實很美. (19) [Subtitle]: 細節圓潤度都做得很好.
